Hi Teemu,

You're welcome to bring the 140L concrete mixer back to Kempele during our normal opening hours — no need to book a time, just make sure it's clean and all the attachments are with it so the deposit can be returned in full.

Still keen to get you booked in for the diamond floor saw too — whenever you have dates in mind, let me know and I'll check the calendar.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy
